strings.ix.title: Restaurants und Cafés
strings.ix.heroSum: Ihr Wegweiser zum Essen in Al-Ahsa: ausgewählte Restaurants, Cafés und Bäckereien für „rotes Brot“ in Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung – von Kulturerbe-Ambiente und traditioneller Hausmannskost bis zu modernen Lokalen und Spezialitätenkaffee – jeweils mit Foto und Standort in Google Maps, einen Klick entfernt. Die Liste wächst stetig weiter.
strings.ix.bakeriesNote: Dattelbrot und rotes Brot sind ein und dasselbe – zwei Namen für ein Gericht. Hier wird dafür der Tanur (Lehmofen) angefeuert.

strings.ix.hoursNote: Die Öffnungszeiten stammen von Google Maps und können sich ändern – prüfen Sie den Link zu diesem Ort.

termbase_additions.source: Web-verifiziert (Stage 3, 2026-09-19): 'Spezialitätenkaffee' ist der in der deutschen Kaffeebranche etablierte, stabile Begriff (auch parallel zu 'Specialty Coffee' verwendet) — bestätigt u. a. bei roastmarket.de/magazin/der-specialty-coffee/, coffeeness.de/specialty-coffee/, cafesito.de/blog/spezialitaeten-kaffee/ und im Umfeld des Deutschen Kaffeeverbands e. V. (kaffeeverband.de), der u. a. rund 180 Spezialitätenröstereien als Mitglieder führt. Genus unstrittig, vom Grundwort 'der Kaffee' bestimmt.

notes: heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style food) - kept close to en ('traditionelle Gerichte'); not reconciled per instructions, flagged for stage 2+.

heroSum: en 'modern spots' vs ar 'المطاعم العصرية' (modern restaurants) - translated 'moderne Lokale' (avoids repeating 'Restaurants' three times in one sentence and avoids Denglisch 'Spots'); fact preserved (modern eating places).

ix.districtLabel/ix.districtAll: chose 'Gebiet'/'Alle Gebiete' rather than reusing det.area='Lage' verbatim - 'Lage' pluralizes awkwardly ('Lagen') for a multi-option dropdown of districts/streets/cities; 'Gebiet' stays a neutral non-administrative term (avoids 'Bezirk') and pluralizes naturally. ix.searchPh echoes the same concept ('Gebiet').

Tanur gloss placement: per gloss_regel the gloss belongs at first running-text occurrence, not a heading/eyebrow - ix.bakeriesEyebrow stays 'Tanur' unglossed, gloss placed in ix.bakeriesNote as 'der Tanur (Lehmofen)' (singular, generic/collective use across the group of bakeries), matching the termbase form exactly.

'rotes Brot' is quoted in „...“ at its first running-text occurrence on the page (ix.heroSum), matching the published /de/food/ dish-card convention; left unquoted afterwards in ix.bakeriesH and ix.bakeriesNote. 'Dattelbrot' appears in ix.bakeriesNote, satisfying the C5b pairing guard on this page.
Added termbase entry for 'Spezialitätenkaffee' (specialty coffee) - no prior termbase entry existed; generic compound noun, gender unambiguous from the head noun 'der Kaffee'.
ix.title = 'Restaurants und Cafés' matches the published nav.dine string verbatim (it serves as H1, breadcrumb label, tab title and ItemList name per pack.json context).

STAGE 2 (editor) — closed translator's open question on heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style, not merely 'traditional'). Replaced 'traditionellen Gerichten' with 'traditioneller Hausmannskost' - a native, idiomatic German noun that carries exactly the home-style/folk connotation ar adds, while 'traditioneller' keeps en's explicit word too. No fact added or dropped, just a more precise register match.
STAGE 2 — fixed a pleonasm in ix.bakeriesNote: stage 1's 'Tanur-Öfen (Lehmöfen)' literally said 'oven-ovens'. Rewrote using the termbase form directly, singular/generic. C5b pairing preserved.
STAGE 2 — ix.hoursNote: 'den Link des Ortes' was a calque of the English possessive; replaced with 'den Link zu diesem Ort'. Same referent, Sie-form kept.
STAGE 2 — ix.heroSum: removed a stacked '–,' before 'jeweils mit Foto…'; a single Halbgeviertstrich already separates the clause, matching the published /de/stay/ heroSum punctuation.

STAGE 2 — verified locked Google Maps strings byte-for-byte unchanged; ix.srcNote tail, ix.moreLabel (no arrow), ix.searchPh (ends in …), ix.emptyMsg quoting, and the Dattelbrot/rotes Brot pairing all re-checked and intact.
STAGE 2 — no Satzklammer, Denglisch, exclamation-mark, or superlative-stacking issues found elsewhere; register, case endings after termbase names and Sie-form usage confirmed correct on review.

STAGE 3 (cultural adapter, DACH) — register check confirmed: 'Hausmannskost' is the right idiomatic match for ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (home-style/folk food, as opposed to fine dining) - it is a warm, native German noun a DACH reader immediately reads as 'honest, everyday cooking', not a literal calque of 'traditional food'. Kept as-is from stage 2.

STAGE 3 — register check confirmed: 'Gebiet' reads naturally as a dropdown filter label for a list of districts/streets/cities (parallel to real-world travel-site filters like 'Bereich'/'Gebiet'), unlike 'Bezirk' (administrative) or 'Lage' (awkward plural, and already carries a different sense — 'location relative to the visitor' — on detail pages). Kept as-is from stage 2.

STAGE 3 — heroSum: changed 'Al-Mubarraz und der Umgebung' to 'Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung'. 'X und Umgebung' (no article) is the standard German toponymic collocation for 'X and its surrounding area' (cf. 'München und Umgebung', 'Rothenburg und Umgebung'); 'und der Umgebung' reads as a translated calque rather than the idiom a DACH reader expects. No fact changed — same three-way list (Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz, surrounding area).

STAGE 3 — considered reordering ix.bakeriesNote to lead with 'Rotes Brot' (matching the en source's exact order and the H2 right above it, which has just introduced 'rotes Brot') — but reverted: the C5b guard's pattern for this pairing is case-sensitive and only matches lowercase 'rot(e|es|er|en|em)? Brot'; putting it at the sentence start forces a capital 'Rotes', which the guard does not recognise as the required pair-member and fails the build (verified by running verify-stage.mjs with the reordered string: 'الزوج «rotes Brot»/«Dattelbrot» معاً (C5b)' failed). Kept stage 2's order 'Dattelbrot und rotes Brot sind ein und dasselbe …', where 'rotes' stays lowercase mid-sentence and the guard passes. No fact, word, or punctuation otherwise changed; the Tanur gloss is untouched.

STAGE 3 — verified via WebSearch that 'Spezialitätenkaffee' is the genuinely stable, in-use German term for specialty coffee (not a stage-2 guess): confirmed across roastmarket.de, coffeeness.de, cafesito.de and in the vocabulary of the Deutscher Kaffeeverband e. V. Updated the termbase_additions source field from 'no web verification possible' to this citation; kept de/artikel/status unchanged since the word itself was already correct.

STAGE 3 — no other fence violations found: nothing added beyond what en/ar state (no visiting hours, no prices, no recommendation, no invented sensory detail). All ten trap items from the brief re-checked and remain satisfied after the two edits above.
